name: @voiden/plugin-bruno-importer
description: Import a Bruno (usebruno.com) .bru request file, or a whole OpenCollection YAML/JSON export, into Voiden — converts method/url, headers, query/path params, body, auth, scripts, and assert blocks into native .void blocks.

scripts.release: node build.mjs && node build-main.mjs && node generate-manifest.mjs
